short.text: Jason Babin was Jacksonville's lead edge rusher in 2013, first in every recorded edge order, and dressed for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games. Camp marked him as the club's leading edge-pressure option, built on his get-off, bend and a useful rush plan, and he finished the regular season with {{2013.regular.sacks:words}} sacks. His run defense at the point of attack, block shedding and contain discipline were below his value as a rusher.

transactions.text: Signed a five-year contract with Philadelphia
Claimed off waivers by Jacksonville, carrying his Philadelphia contract
Traded by Jacksonville to Miami, with Jacksonville's 2017 seventh-round pick, for Miami's 2015 third-round pick
